newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Four workers die in Russian mine blast.
newsitem.headline: Four workers die in Russian mine blast.

text.p: Four miners died on Monday when methane exploded in a coal pit in Russia's southern Urals region, an Emergencies Ministry spokesman said.
He said the accident occured when the workers were using explosives to enlarge the pit, but could not give the exact cause of the blast.

Explosions have become frequent in Russian mines, most of which are short of funds for minimal safety maintenance. Interfax news agency quoted miners union officials as saying that 12 workers had died in mine blasts in January.
